name: Landscape for Breeding and Training of Ceremonial Carriage Horses at Kladruby nad Labem
description: In the flat Elbe floodplain of eastern Bohemia, this working stud farm has bred Kladruber horses since 1579, when it was founded for the Habsburg Imperial Court. These Baroque carriage horses pulled rulers in ceremonial processions. The surrounding pastures, meadows, tree-lined avenues, oxbow lakes and farm buildings were arranged to serve the horses while also looking like a designed park.
